name: R peak
description: Location of the R wave peak (QRS detection)

name: QRS onset
description: Start of the QRS complex (Q onset / R onset)

name: Per-sample P/QRS/T labels
description: Each sample labelled as P / QRS / T / none (segmentation mask)

name: RR interval
description: Time between consecutive R peaks (mean or series)

name: RR interval standard deviation
description: Spread of RR intervals within a recording

name: PQ interval
description: P onset to Q onset (PR synonym in some tools)

name: QTc (other / unspecified correction)
description: Corrected QT with another or unstated formula

name: TP interval
description: T offset to next P onset

name: QT dispersion
description: Max minus min QT across leads

name: Q / R / S / R' / S' wave durations
description: Durations of the individual QRS deflections

name: ST level / deviation
description: ST amplitude at J or J+x ms relative to baseline

name: Wave morphology descriptors
description: Polarity / biphasic / notching / R', S' presence / symmetry / peak time

name: QRS-T angle / vectorcardiographic features
description: Spatial or frontal QRS-T angle and other VCG measures

name: Other entropy / fractal / complexity of RR
description: Multiscale, fuzzy, Shannon entropy, Higuchi, correlation dimension, etc.

name: Heart-rate asymmetry / fragmentation
description: GI, SI, AI, PI, PIP, IALS, PSS, PAS

name: Statistical descriptors
description: Mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis, percentiles, etc.

name: Temporal descriptors
description: Zero crossings, autocorrelation, slopes, peaks, etc.

name: Spectral descriptors
description: Spectral centroid, entropy, band power, wavelet energy, etc.

name: Fractal / nonlinear dynamics of the signal
description: DFA, Hurst, Lyapunov, Higuchi, Katz, Petrosian, etc.
